value: Micro sidescroller adventure game made as a collaboration between Kitamiya and JellyTea.

Your character comes from a world where heroes are trained before being sent to save other worlds. While in transit to a “Normal” difficulty world, you are flicked away, and the world is destroyed by a giant girl. The hero wakes up on another world, confused by his surroundings, but decides to venture forth into the world with the help of his AI assistant. Time to Complete: <30 minutes
Advance through a sidescrolling environment while dodging stomps by falling into cracks, or powering a magic shield by spamming a button, allowing you to endure any impact.
